milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate toward the glass panes at the building entrance and face them, confirming they have visually located the glass panes. With 4 gravel blocks available and only a 10% chance per block to drop flint instead, the probability of getting zero gravel from 4 blocks is 0.0001 (negligible). The mined gravel item ends up in inventory, making inventory_has the most direct check.
